text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing repeated Xid 48 on rack-r1 card 342 since 03:12 UTC. Patterns: small-batch inference (batch_size=1), short seq len (<32).

tia: noticed same on r1-341 last night. NIC had a few drops around same time. Could be network backpressure + NV driver handling.

opsbot: ALERT: gpu.r1-342 reported Xid=48 (2026-03-19T03:12:05Z) 3x in 2m. Auto-throttle applied.

maria: can you paste dmesg / driver logs? add `nvidia-smi` output too.

alex: paste below — short snippets: 
```
[  903.123456] NVRM: Xid (048): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  903.123459] nvidia 0000:65:00.0: Xid 48 Detected
[  905.000001] Kernel: pcie link down/up events
```
`nvidia-smi -q -d PERF,UTIL` shows GPU busy ~60% but mem util low.

sam: tenant `search-embed` is an obvious candidate — they do a lot of tiny requests (PLG traffic). We've gradually moved them to these racks because of capacity.

noah: quick hypothesis: small batches => lots of socket churn, transient NIC packet drops => driver path triggers Xid48. Could reproduce by hammering small requests locally.

tia: steps I'd run: 
1) run `ethtool -S eth0` and check for rx_err/drop counters during a repro.
2) run `stress-infer --model small --batch 1 --seq 16 --duration 10m` pinned to r1-342 while monitoring `dmesg -w`.
3) try disabling NVLink on that host to see if it reduces Xid frequency.

maria: also check PCIe link speed (`lspci -vvv | grep -A20 -i nvidia | egrep "LnkSta|LinkCap"`) — sometimes link retrains with bad cables.

alex: ran ethtool during a run — rx_errors spiked from 0 to 120 in 2m. `ifconfig` shows occasional carrier drops.

opsbot: NOTE: raidops scheduled a dataflow change to search-embed yesterday at 02:50 UTC. Could have increased small-payload qps.

sam: we can mitigate quickly by routing search-embed to other racks (r2/r3) for 1h to see if Xid stops. That buys us time to replace cable or repro in isolation.

noah: decision: soft-drain r1-342 (evict noncritical pods), migrate search-embed, run reproduction with NIC stress and pcie-cable swap. If Xid stops after cable swap -> supplier RMA.

maria: I'll book a maintenance window for 03:40 UTC. ops will do cable swap and NVLink isolate.

alex: after migration, Xid events dropped to 0 in the 15m baseline. Good sign.

tia: still want a full postmortem: include telemetry linking batch_shape=1 traffic from tenant -> Xid48 counts, NIC rx_err timeline, and link retrain events. Add a recommendation: soft-queue small-batch tenants onto less-congested NICs and add automated detector for rapid route-off when rx_err > threshold. :memo:

maria: assigning owner for follow-up: @noah — can you own the RMA writeup and config change for route-off? 

noah: got it — will produce RCA + config PR (auto-route-off threshold) by EOD.

alex: thanks all.
